errors.evidence: The x-axis in the figure is not labeled with any numerical values, years, or intervals. This entire description of the x-axis is fabricated.
The description omits the label for the y-axis, which is 'Индустрия (с изкл. на строителството) Общо' (Industry (excluding construction) Total).
The line starts at a value of approximately 36.5, not 35.5.
The line ends at a value of approximately 31.5, not 30.5.

errors.text_span: Има лек спад в полезната стойност от 35,5% до 30,5%.
errors.evidence: Describing the trend as a 'slight drop' is an oversimplification. The line drops, then flattens, dips slightly, and then rises at the end. It is not a monotonic decrease.
The phrase 'полезната стойност' (which translates to 'the useful value') is awkward and inappropriate in this context.
